transcription.source: a gitignored working note dated 2026-09-04, n4_edge_ablation_n8_2026-09-04.md, which a clone does not carry
transcription.method: the note's results table copied cell for cell: 8 full-arm, 8 self-loop-only and 8 paired-delta pooled AUC-PR values, each at 6 decimals, in the note's seed order. Nothing was recomputed or re-rounded.
transcription.added_columns: seed, run_tag_full and run_tag_self_loop_only. The run tags are the names of the local run directories under models/scratch/ that hold each run's out-of-fold frame.
transcription.paired_delta_rounding: paired_delta_self_loop_only_minus_full was computed from unrounded AUC-PR and rounded once, so it is not always the difference of the two rounded arm columns: for seeds 42 and 123 it differs from that difference by 0.000001. Recomputing the delta from the arm columns changes those two cells.

upstream_runs.trainer: src/train_gnn.py --architecture v2, two arms identical except --edge-mode (full, self-loop-only)
upstream_runs.held_fixed_per_the_note: v5 corpus, models/peptide_binding_matrix_v5.csv, ESM-2 embeddings data/esm2_embeddings_t12_v5.pt, feature mode 31, mean pooling, 18 epochs, early-stopping patience 10, one shared feature cache
upstream_runs.primary_quantity: pooled AUC-PR: sklearn average_precision_score over each run's own out-of-fold frame, gnn_oof_predictions_mean.csv

verification.method: pooled AUC-PR re-derived with sklearn average_precision_score from each of the 16 local out-of-fold frames listed under inputs
verification.result: all 24 transcribed values reproduce at 6 decimals
verification.arm_identity: each run directory's run1/gnn_config_mean.json records an edge_mode equal to the arm named in its tag, 16 of 16

statistics_from_this_file.method: computed from this file's 6-decimal values; delta is self-loop-only minus full; sd uses ddof=1; CI is the two-sided 95% t interval on n=8; both tests are exact and two-sided
statistics_from_this_file.note: The working note's paired t = 6.037 was computed from unrounded values; from this file's rounded values it reads 6.038. No tracked doc quotes t.

inputs_note: local and gitignored: present only on the machine that ran the ablation, so a clone cannot re-derive the transcribed values from them
